title: Choose the page structure
question: The plan/drawing world stays, now bold with Ginstergelb as a colour field and full scroll choreography. Lock the structure the page is built on.

options.label: Schnitt durch die Schule
options.thesis: The page is one section cut through a school; scrolling descends through its rooms, and each room is a chapter.
materials: real room photography in the cut
options.viewport: Full-bleed Ginstergelb field; a giant ink section of a two-storey school cut open across the lower 60%, headline 'Lernräume für Südtirol.' set huge in Archivo top-left, ink CTA 'Projekt anfragen'.
options.risk: Section drawing must stay legible at phone width; it re-flows to one room per screen there.

options.label: Die Maßkette
options.thesis: One giant dimension chain carries the page: each segment is a step, and the room plan builds beneath it as you scroll sideways.
options.viewport: Ginstergelb sheet; a full-width room plan in ink with a 7,20 m chain along its base; headline stacked left, the chain's first tick lit as 'Beraten'.
options.risk: Horizontal pinned scroll must degrade to a vertical chain on phones and under reduced motion.

regions.label: dimension chain: Beraten · Planen · Ausstatten · Umsetzen · Begleiten

options.label: Das Leistungsverzeichnis
options.lineage: municipal tender dossiers and plan title blocks
options.thesis: The page reads as a project dossier a Gemeinde knows: numbered positions, title blocks, annexed plan sheets, and a blank position the visitor fills in.
options.viewport: A Ginstergelb cover sheet with a ruled title block (Projekt, Ort, Phase, Ansprechpartner), 'Lernräume für Südtirol.' as the project title, CTA as 'Pos. 06 — Ihr Projekt'.
options.risk: Can read bureaucratic if type and colour are set timidly.
